meta.title: Governed Data Pipeline: Current Registration State
meta.subtitle: Observed from the successful production registration run at 2026-08-28 03:30 UTC. Counts are operational snapshots, not source-data totals.

views.label: 1. Discovery
views.note: External catalogs are queried only by the scheduled discovery job; their responses are captured as immutable artifacts.

views.label: 2. Registration
views.note: Every 15 minutes, one artifact is safely converted into governed catalog records and provenance observations.

views.label: 3. Approval gate
views.note: Registration creates research leads only. It never authorizes data acquisition.

views.label: 4. Approved source
views.note: Only a steward-approved source version can enter RAW and then dbt transformations.

cards.title: What is running now
items: Latest run: 1 artifact, 100 catalog datasets, and 200 catalog resources.
4,402 of 4,410 artifacts remain; this is intentional checkpointed backlog processing.

cards.title: Why it takes time
items: The one-artifact cap bounds memory and runtime on the scheduled worker.
At the observed rate, the remaining backlog is about 46 days if every artifact needs its own run.
The job is resumable: it records a checkpoint only after the Snowflake writes succeed.

cards.title: What it does not do
items: It does not download full datasets, run dbt, or publish analytical results.
It does not approve a source or activate a source version.
The approval gate prevents a catalog listing from becoming an automatic ingestion.
